run_appveyor_build: run the appveyor build script to configure, build, and test the fmt library on Windows
run_cmake_configure: run cmake configuration with pedantic mode enabled for the fmt library
run_mingw_build: run the MinGW build using mingw32-make with 4 parallel jobs
run_visual_studio_build: run the Visual Studio build using cmake with MSBuild for the fmt library
run_ctest: run ctest to execute the test suite for the fmt library build
